notes.title: VR Fest 2023 is underway!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27229309/d4a3b1811d5ffbacf2308fc3e6d1b3eab9c1f617.png[/img]

Greetings Gakusei,

We are delighted to announce that Sky Sanctuary is participating in VR Fest 2023. Join our community and enjoy a 30% discount on the purchase of the game. It's the perfect time to embark on the path of the samurai!

This announcement is also an opportunity for us to tell you about the next VR rhythm game we have been working on for a year, set to be released in early 2024 on Steam.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2680410/

If you enjoyed Sky Sanctuary and its Taiko mini-game, you should take a look at Taiko Frenzy and add it to your wishlist now!

Grab your drumsticks, keep the beat, and unleash the Taiko master within you!

Taiko Frenzy is a dynamic rhythm game set in a stunning and colorful landscape. Immerse yourself in the world of Japanese folklore with original soundtracks composed exclusively for the game.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExbHg2djB2bHUyejRoZ2libDMxMDJibTN1MW95MThlbW9pMzhka3E5YiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/SXtewtbX3nCgDILc8S/source.gif[/img]

As always, have fun, Gakusei!

notes.title: Patch notes v1.2.0: Arcade Mode
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27229309/cb25500d9790ba4f891802477c6b5780eea413c0.png[/img]

Hello gakusei,

Big update today for Sky Sanctuary: the game now features Arcade mode. This mode allows you to launch the game with all the mini-games unlocked and directly accessible via a simple menu..

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/mDj48O3JF8GbrALBnY/giphy.gif[/img]

In this mode, the exploration and progression aspects of the player are completely disabled. Some achievements will only be unlockable on the original version of the game with exploration. We've also added the leaderboards for all temple mini-games.

[h1]Général[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Arcade mode accessible as a game launch option
    [*]Added leaderboards for temple minigames
[/list]

The game is also on sale during the Steam Autumn Sales, so now is the perfect time to join our community of samurai apprentices!

Have fun gakusei! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Release version is now live!
notes.notes:
Greetings gakusei,

It’s been 3 years since we released the game in Early Access. It’s been hard for us as a small studio to survive out there but here we are today. We have been working for other people on many VR experiences and we have finally managed to find the money to finish the development. We are very proud to bring you today the complete version of Sky Sanctuary. We have put our heart in this game and now, we are really excited to see you guys playing it.

Our goal was to make a VR game for everyone (kids and adults) without violence in a charming environment with different activities.

We want people all around the world to have fun exploring this secret sanctuary beyond the clouds. That’s why the game has been translated in several languages: English, French, Japanese, Korean, Russian and Simplified Chinese.

A lot of work has also been done on the environment to make you feel at peace with zen vibes and beautiful places.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27229309/672785c3bc887f96463e42f32965be025863d38e.png[/img]

The existing mini games have been improved and new ones now await you (including a Taiko rhythm experience). We won’t spoil anything else here, it’s better for you to discover it by yourself. All you need to know is that the final version offers now much more variety in gameplays.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/W5lXmEJbQdtIMSzIQR/giphy.gif[/img]

We have also added difficulty levels in almost every mini game to let you guys play at your own pace. And for competitive players out there, don’t worry we’ve got you covered with competitives modes and leaderboards in the main activities. Let’s see if you deserve your place in the top 3 commemorative statues!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/kEion5M3yzlH9tNYVd/giphy.gif[/img]

For achievements hunters, you might want to know that there are now 74 achievements waiting for you to unlock them. Oh and we also have implemented a rich presence system to let your friends know what you are doing in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27229309/8e554d39a65ddb314617594de78cf7ad08bd0abe.png[/img]

Every achievement and leaderboard has been wiped for everyone though, but it’s for the best because the game has fundamentally changed since Early Access and it now deserves a fresh new start for everyone. 

We want to thank our early access players for their useful feedback and their trust. We also want to thank the Région Nouvelle Aquitaine that brought us financial support to make this game release possible.

We hope each one of you will enjoy playing our game as much as we enjoyed working on it. If you have any questions / feedback, feel free to get in touch with us on community forums or on our discord: [url=https://discord.gg/Hc7Xqvs]discord.gg/Hc7Xqvs[/url]

Welcome to the mini games collection for true samurais.



Glitchr Studio: Gautier, Thomas and Bob

notes.title: Brace yourself, Sky Sanctuary release is coming
notes.notes:
Greetings gakusei,

The wait is almost over, and we can tell it was worth it. Sky Sanctuary is releasing on Friday in a complete version with new mini-games, enhanced graphics universe and other suprises.

We hope you'll be there and we are excited to get your feedbacks on your experience with the game.

It's important to know that the game has only been tested on HTC Vive and Oculus headsets (Rift, Rift S and Quest with Oculus Link). So issues might remain on Valve Index and Vive Cosmos as we don't own those headsets. We are counting on your vigilance to tell us if you encounter any issue on those headsets so that we can quickly provide a corrective update if it's needed.

We'll give you more information on the new game content on friday. Get ready for a new trailer as well!

Thanks for your support, you can still contact us on our Discord:[url=https://discord.gg/Hc7Xqvs]discord.gg/Hc7Xqvs[/url]

notes.title: New financial partners, new release date
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We know it's always tricky to announce that we have to delay an official game release. But in our case, we can ensure you it's for the best.

A new financial partner has joined the adventure to help us fund Sky Sanctuary final development: the [i]Région Nouvelle Aquitaine[/i]

With this money, we are now able to implement a lot of ideas we had in mind like for instance:
[list]
[*] Go deeper in the art direction to have a well balanced mix between nature and technology
[*] Work hard on sound design with new musics, new ambiences, and add some variety in the sfx
[*] Translate the game in several languages that were not supported yet like Russian, Chinese or Japanese
[*] Finish the development and polish the 7 new mini games that we are working on
[/list]

With that in mind, we are delaying the release date to offer you the best experience with the game. And that new budget allows us to go further than we thought back then.

We'll have to keep you waiting until [b]Spring 2020[/b]. In the meantime, here is a sneak peek of 2 new mini games that will be in the final game:

[h1]Dodge and Slice[/h1]
[url=https://gph.is/g/ZWM90bo][img]https://media.giphy.com/media/Q8UJhrgFSCuNsldWh1/giphy.gif[/img][/url]

[h1]Sharp Darts[/h1]
[url=https://gph.is/g/aK8orpe][img]https://media.giphy.com/media/XfPJikEBNhIdk5uUCA/giphy.gif[/img][/url]

Thank you very much for your support, it means a lot to us. Please add Sky Sanctuary to your wishlist if you're interested in the game, it helps us a lot!

You can now reach us on Discord : [url=https://discord.gg/Hc7Xqvs]discord.gg/Hc7Xqvs[/url]

Prepare yourself gakuseis, training will be hard. ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Delios is back: Upcoming Sky Sanctuary Release
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229309/890c059a7061e14b2c8fe940ae3ce07f5aa2b50f.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

Long time no see! Sorry for being silent about the project in the past few years. As a small team, we had a hard time figuring out how to find enough money to finance the complete version of Sky Sanctuary. We have made the choice to rework the project scope in order to respect a limited budget.

But we have good news for you gakuseis: [b]the release version of Sky Sanctuary is coming to you by the end of the year![/b] ːsteamhappyːːsteamhappyːːsteamhappyː

[h1]New content, new games[/h1]
We are back on working on the game since March 2019 and what we can tell you is that the development is moving forward at a good pace. We are planning on releasing Sky Sanctuary by December 2019!

What it means for you is, as everyone asked, more content:
[list]
[*] At least 6 new mini games,
[*] Training and competitive modes for main mini games to be able to chill or to live a more intense challenge
[*] New Leaderboards
[*] Improved environment and optimizations
[*] And other surprises
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229309/ae9b84c5a950a489bcbccb44f8dc66a0bd44f491.png[/img]

[h1]New price at release[/h1]
We have another good news for new players out there: [b]the release version will be sold at a reduced price under 10$.[/b] The new price will be announced soon. The current price will remain the same until december. If you really want to support us, you can buy the early access version at a higher price, otherwise you should wait the release version to buy it cheaper.

[h1]New FAQ[/h1]
The FAQ has also been updated to reflect the changes that occured in the project: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/526130/discussions/0/135509124601604984/]Sky Sanctuary FAQ[/url]

We hope you will enjoy the new version of Sky Sanctuary, we have put a lot of love in it. Stay tuned on our social networks if you want to see some work in progress stuff like for instance our "Whack a mole" prototype:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229309/2b6f92c6caec87201220fc904d6d536f9b57b322.png[/img]

We now have a Discord server if you want to chat with us directly: [url=https://discord.gg/Hc7Xqvs]https://discord.gg/Hc7Xqvs[/url]

Cheers! ːsteammockingː

notes.title: Patch notes v0.4.1: Oculus Touch Support
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229309/5d66c143a1f11b8edcc1e1bee063e8bbb4303510.png[/img]

Hello everyone.

Good news for all the Oculus owners out there who are eagerly waiting to get their hands on Sky Sanctuary: we finally did it!

We have added the Oculus Touch support on SteamVR, you can now slice tatami rolls / aim with your bow using your Oculus Touch ːsteamhappyː.

To support the 180° tracking, we have added a feature to let you rotate in the world by 90°. All you have to do is using the [b]X button[/b] to rotate left and the [b]A button[/b] to rotate right: just like you would in The Lab.

If you have any issue with your device detection, try to launch the game and SteamVR with administrator rights.

The next step in this Oculus support journey will be to work on the native Oculus SDK integration so that we can release the game on the Oculus Store.

If you experiment any weird behaviour with your Oculus, please report it in Steam forums in order to get a fix quickly.

We can't wait to see how you perform on Sky Sanctuary gakuseis! ːsteammockingː

notes.title: Patch notes v0.4.0: Gold and Shadows
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229309/c13db075121d4d796252987fb01232867a862de8.png[/img]

[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Unity has been updated to version 5.6. No more weird blue shadows! The power of shadowmasks.
    [*]Many third party plugins have been updated.
    [*]Sounds are now integrated with Wwise.
    [*]General rework of the sound engine.
    [*]New text engine (TextMesh Pro).
    [*]Reworked materials and geometry on many meshes.
    [*]Cutting engine now works with two or more swords to cut the same object with a coherent behavior. New content patch incoming!
[/list]
[h1]Content[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Players can now compete to be celebrated on whole new monuments for kyudo and tameshigiri modes.
    [*]Kyudo Skeet mode has been reworked. Enjoy the golden hense!
    [*]You can now train on skeets and sliceable projectiles in the beginner zone.
[/list]
[h1]Bug fixes and optimizations[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Drawcalls have been reduced by more than half: 30+fps gain on weakest setups.
    [*]Game should not be tanked anymore when you quit.
    [*]Henses are no more deactivated when colliding with a projectile that doesn’t get stuck in it.
    [*]Holographic shader should now work as expected (no more incoherent artifacts and SPSR fixed).
    [*]Minimum sword cutting volume is now adjusted to the real mesh volume instead of the bounding box volume.
    [*]Vegetation imposters are now batched together.
[/list]

As the Skeet mode has completly evolved, we have reset the Skeet and Triathlon leaderboards. Sorry folks, but you'll have to compete again to be worthy of the new Altars highlights ːsteamhappyː

To celebrate this new update, you can get Sky Sanctuary at 25% off during the next couple of weeks, hope you enjoy it, gakuseis.

notes.title: Patch notes v0.3.1: Fixes and improvements
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229309/61f6d2419ea2ec971802dac04a1cdd9e6b510fab.png[/img]

[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Weapon swapping disabled in game modes
    [*]New dialog system: you can now manually pass important sentences. You have all the time you want to read important instructions
    [*]Better reading time calculation for automatic dialogs: you now have more time to read, based on international words/minute average
    [*]Delios robot relocate when you come too close so that you can easily read the dialog content (moving animation will come later)
    [*]Game engine updated to Unity 5.5.2 (you may experiment some frame drops, we are working on optimizations)
    [*]SteamVR and other third party plugins updated to last version
    [*]Physics optimization
    [*]PBR textures and materials updated
    [*]Clouds tweaking
[/list]
[h1]Content[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Added some fireflies near environment elements (VFX)
    [*]Added a new localization system to easily support more languages in the future
[/list]
[h1]Bug fixes and optimizations[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Unpredictable projectile physics behavior fixed
    [*]Tatami rolls projection fixed during the Tameshigiri game (you won't receive any chunk in your face anymore)
    [*]Lighting blink on dynamic elements fixed
    [*]Light reflections fixed
    [*]Weird automatic height teleport fixed (you won't be teleported anymore when you put a teapot on your face, sorry)
    [*]Bad occlusion culling (in the temple for instance) fixed
    [*]Physics optimization
    [*]GPU textures size adjustments
    [*]Particle systems optimized with LOD
    [*]LOD distances adjusted to fit different cameras/headsets
    [*]Katana outline fixed
    [*]Offline unlockables fixed (in certain conditions, you couldn't unlock the game modes when you were offline)

notes.notes:

[list]
    [*]Weapon swapping disabled in game modes
    [*]New dialog system: you can now manually pass important sentences. You have all the time you want to read important instructions
    [*]Better reading time calculation for automatic dialogs: you now have more time to read, based on international words/minute average
    [*]Delios robot relocate when you come too close so that you can easily read the dialog content (moving animation will come later)

    [*]Physics optimization
    [*]PBR textures and materials updated
    [*]Clouds tweaking

notes.title: First update incoming
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229309/548ff540ff057739e9f7dd03fb958087503a758a.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone,

We are working on the first update since the release on Steam and we wanted to release it this week.

[h1]Update coming next week[/h1]
But we had a few issues in the development that makes us schedule this update next week:
[list]
    [*]Our HTC Vive was pretty much dead and we had to send it back to the HTC customer service. It's ok now, we've received a new one.
    [*]To optimize the game, we wanted to update our game engine (Unity) to the 5.5.2 version. Something in the process broke the game scene textures and we needed a few days to figure this out
[/list]

Now that we are ok with all of this, we are working on fixes and optimizations  that will be implemented in the next week update.

A patch note will be available along with the new version of Sky Sanctuary.

[h1]Oculus Touch support[/h1]
We have received the Oculus and Oculus Touch this week. We can now work on the Oculus support! This support won't be implemented in the next week update but probably in another patch during March.

See you next week gakusei ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Oculus Touch news + Nominated to Laval Virtual Awards
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27229309/ff450ffb5a4bdd12ef138e4f62f25e04720c1a1c.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone,

We have a good news for Oculus Touch owners who want to get their hands on Sky Sanctuary: The Oculus team will send us a couple of devices so that we can work on Oculus Touch support for the game. It means that we'll soon be able to see what we can do so you guys can play the game ːsteamhappyː.

We're also very happy to announce that Sky Sanctuary has been nominated for the Laval Virtual Awards. Laval Virtual is a prestigious international event about new AR/VR content taking place every year in France. We'll present the game to professionals and general public so they can test it.
That's a good opportunity for us to collect more direct feedbacks and have some visibility for the future.

That's all folks, be patient, we're working on a minor update for the next week. It will improve and fix a couple of things to enhance your experience with the game. Stay tuned!
